seo.description: Sunflower Babies is a free weekly class where parents of newborns, infants and young toddlers (up to 16 months) make friends and support each other in Delray Beach, FL.

hero.title: Sunflower Babies
hero.lead: A free weekly class for infants to age 16 months and their grown-ups.

image.alt: Sunflower Babies banner showing a parent and baby at Sunflower Creative Arts

sections.heading: About Sunflower Babies
sections.html:
Infants to age 16 months, with adult

In Sunflower Babies, parents of newborns, infants and young toddlers make friends and support each other in a cozy, caring environment. Share and learn with families who are going through the same joys and challenges. Conversations will focus on feeding, postpartum adjustment, sleeping, partner relationships, development, and more. Parents are welcome to attend a class prior to birth.

Classes will meet on Wednesdays from 8:15–9:00 am. Sunflower Babies is a free class.

image.alt: A parent dressing a baby during a Sunflower Babies class

sections.html: “I absolutely loved Sunflower Babies and learned so much. My son had such a great time. He crawled and stood for the first time at Sunflower!”

sections.heading: Interested in joining us for the 2026–27 school year? You can still apply!
sections.html: While our official application period has ended, we encourage interested families to submit an application using the button below. If space is currently available, we’ll be in touch with next steps. If a program is full, your child will be added to the waitlist, and we will call or email you when a spot becomes available.
